name: io.github.lazyants/transkribus
description: Transkribus REST and Processing APIs — collections, HTR/OCR; default v1, optional v2 beta.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSKRIBUS_USER
environmentVariables.description: Account email; use with TRANSKRIBUS_PASSWORD when credentials are absent from the OS keyring.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSKRIBUS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Account password; use with TRANSKRIBUS_USER when credentials are absent from the OS keyring.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSKRIBUS_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Existing session ID for the legacy API; an alternative to account credentials.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSKRIBUS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OIDC bearer token for the Processing API; an alternative to account credentials.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSKRIBUS_KEYRING_SERVICE
environmentVariables.description: OS keyring service containing account credentials or a legacy session ID.
